decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The controlled comparison shows Method M-dynamic scoring higher with FILTER/NN than without on every reported metric, supporting the stated contribution without claiming significance (exp2/cmp2; T2.r7; T2.r8).

decisions.label: UNDERSTATED
decisions.rationale: The four listed improvements occurred, but KA also improved from 73.92 to 74.27; thus saying four of five understates the result (T1.r1; T1.r3; exp1/cmp1).

decisions.label: SUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: The with-versus-without ablation reports higher scores with FILTER/NN across all metrics, and “indicating” appropriately frames contribution as an inference rather than statistical proof (exp2/cmp2; T2.r7; T2.r8).

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: T1 supplies differences but no criterion or source characterization establishing that they are “small”; several differences also vary materially in magnitude across systems and languages (T1).

decisions.label: UNSUPPORTED
decisions.rationale: KA COMET increased from 73.92 under supervised fine-tuning to 74.27 for Method M-dynamic, directly contradicting “decreased” (T1.r1.ka; T1.r3.ka).
